phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Business Foundations & Accounting Discovery — Build quantitative literacy, explore the accounting profession, and develop professional identity.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and accounting career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to accounting career pathways including public accounting, corporate finance, government audit, and forensic accounting. Students develop a strengths-based career exploration plan.

milestones.label: Master financial accounting fundamentals
milestones.description: Introduction to the accounting cycle, financial statements, and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Students prepare income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements for service and merchandising enterprises.

milestones.label: Complete managerial accounting foundations
milestones.description: Cost-volume-profit analysis, budgeting, variance analysis, and management decision-making using accounting data. Students apply cost accounting methods to manufacturing and service organizations.

milestones.label: Join Beta Alpha Psi or Accounting Club
milestones.description: Research and join a CoBE-affiliated accounting organization such as Beta Alpha Psi, the National Association of Black Accountants (NABA) student chapter, or the Accounting Club. Attend a minimum of three meetings and document participation.

milestones.label: Analyze global economic forces in business
milestones.description: Examine macroeconomic and microeconomic principles shaping global business environments. Students analyze international trade, monetary policy, and their impact on accounting and financial reporting standards across borders.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core Accounting Knowledge & Professional Exposure — Deepen technical accounting skills and build industry connections through networking and applied learning.

milestones.label: Master intermediate financial accounting
milestones.description: In-depth study of asset valuation, revenue recognition, and financial statement presentation under GAAP and IFRS. Students analyze complex transactions including leases, pensions, and deferred taxes.

milestones.label: Complete VITA volunteer tax preparation
milestones.description: Participate in the IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) program, preparing federal and state tax returns for low-income community members. Students earn IRS certification and apply tax code knowledge in a service-learning context.

milestones.label: Attend CoBE career fair and Big Four recruiting events
milestones.description: Participate in CoBE-sponsored career fairs and Big Four accounting firm recruiting events. Students practice elevator pitches, submit resumes through Handshake, and conduct follow-up outreach to recruiters.

milestones.label: Analyze international financial reporting standards
milestones.description: Compare U.S. GAAP and IFRS frameworks through case studies of multinational corporations. Students analyze how convergence efforts impact financial reporting for global companies operating across regulatory jurisdictions.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Accounting & CPA Preparation — Build audit and tax expertise, secure mentorship, and complete a summer internship.

milestones.label: Complete auditing and assurance services
milestones.description: Study audit standards, evidence gathering, internal controls, and professional ethics. Students conduct a simulated audit engagement including risk assessment, testing, and audit report preparation following PCAOB and AICPA standards.

milestones.label: Begin CPA exam preparation coursework
milestones.description: Advanced topics including business combinations, consolidated financial statements, governmental accounting, and partnership accounting. Coursework directly maps to CPA exam content areas in FAR and AUD sections.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with an industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a formal mentorship relationship with a CPA or accounting professional through the CoBE Alumni Mentor Network or NABA mentorship program. Meet monthly and document career guidance insights in a structured journal.

milestones.label: Complete summer accounting internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete a structured internship at a public accounting firm, corporate finance department, or government agency. Students apply audit, tax, or advisory skills in a professional setting and submit a comprehensive reflection report.

milestones.label: Analyze forensic accounting and fraud examination
milestones.description: Investigate real-world fraud cases using forensic accounting techniques. Students analyze financial statement fraud, asset misappropriation, and corruption schemes with applications to both domestic and international contexts.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Finalize CPA readiness, complete capstone project, and launch professional career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone accounting research project
milestones.description: Collaborate with a client organization to analyze a complex accounting issue, conduct research using authoritative literature (ASC, IRC), and deliver professional recommendations. Projects are evaluated by faculty and industry professionals.

milestones.label: Complete CPA exam review and 150-hour planning
milestones.description: Finalize CPA exam preparation strategy including 150-credit-hour planning for licensure eligibility. Students complete practice exams, develop a study timeline, and explore MAcc program options at NC A&T and partner institutions.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor for underclassmen
milestones.description: Serve as a peer mentor for first- or second-year accounting students, facilitating study groups, sharing internship strategies, and modeling professional behavior within Beta Alpha Psi or NABA chapters.

milestones.label: Develop industry-specific placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a comprehensive career launch package targeting public accounting, corporate, or government sectors. Includes tailored resume, case interview preparation, and documented network map of industry contacts.

milestones.label: Complete exit competency assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Accounting Exit Assessment measuring competency across program learning outcomes. Finalize career activation status documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or CPA exam registration.
